# WorldViewLink

> **Kind:** component · **Registry:** host · **Folder:** [`src/view/`](../folders/src-view.md)
> **Source:** [`src/view/world_view.h`](../../../src/view/world_view.h)

## Summary

Marks a host entity created by WorldViewSys as the mirror of one shape of a world entity.

## Description

Emplaced by WorldViewSys::tick with Transform and ModelRenderable when a world body or ground is first seen; the host entity is destroyed when the source is no longer seen (or the model cannot be resolved), and all are destroyed in WorldViewSys::finish. WorldViewSys keeps its own map (world, entity) -> host entity and never reads this component back; it exists so other code can identify mirror entities.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `world` | `uint32_t` | (set at creation) | Index of the world in Worlds. |
| `entity` | `entt::entity` | (set at creation) | Source entity in that world's registry. |
